hints.title: Sparse Map Cell Storage
hints.text: Store assigned cell values in a lookup dictionary using the cell string key such as A1 or B10.

hints.title: Cell Reset Handling
hints.text: Resetting a cell removes it from the hash map, reverting its evaluated value to 0.

hints.title: Formula Parsing
hints.text: Strip the leading equal sign and split operands by plus. Sum the operands, resolving cell coordinates against the map or parsing integer constants.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: C: number of modified cells in the spreadsheet
complexity.notes: setCell, resetCell, and getValue run in O(1) average time with two-operand addition.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dense 2D allocation wastes memory for sparse cell usage.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map storage scales with the count of populated cells rather than total grid capacity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Design a clean spreadsheet interface supporting constant-time cell manipulation and formula parsing.
